project_title: NSE Sector Index Market Impact Lab
analysis_universe_note: Primary inference uses 16 long-history NSE sector/industry index series present throughout nearly the full snapshot archive. All index series in the archive are retained in the master long panel and encoded feature dataset; newer and non-sector indices are included in the data inventory but not mixed into the primary sector inference set.

selection_policy.rule: Pre-specified established sector/industry indices with at least 95% of the archive's unique snapshot dates.
selection_policy.indices_not_in_primary_universe: Remain in the all-index master panel and dataset-size audit; excluded from primary regressions because they are newer, non-sector (e.g. volatility, fixed income, factor/strategy), or have shorter coverage.

notes: The supplied archive has 180 distinct Index Name values, including broad-market, sector, thematic, factor/strategy, volatility and fixed-income indices; it is not exclusively a sector-index archive.
NIFTY 50, NIFTY Next 50, NIFTY 100 and NIFTY Midcap 100 are no longer the primary dependent variables.
